stem: Which factors led to the Dust Bowl during the 1930s?

options.label: A
options.text: The expansion of primary and secondary road systems

options.label: B
options.text: The use of poor farming practices and a prolonged drought

options.label: C
options.text: The growth of oil fields and open-pit coal mines

options.label: D
options.text: The mismanagement of river and wetland sources
